_comment: Règles propres à chaque héros, appliquées par-dessus skills.json (calc/damage.apply_mechanics). Clé = clé du héros dans skills.json. Par compétence : 'set' (champs remplacés : trigger, no_crit, aoe...), 'effects' (liste remplacée), 'effects_add' (effets ajoutés). Types d'effets : calc/battle.EFFECT_TYPES. Chaque règle cite le texte du jeu qu'elle traduit ('source') ; voir docs/SIMULATORS.md.

s2.source: Cannot receive recover Health effects and damage sharing effects.

s1.source: When attacking, cannot trigger a critical hit.

s1_bis.source: When attacking, cannot trigger a critical hit.

s3.source: When attacking, cannot trigger a critical hit.

s2.source: At the start of an ally's turn, dispels one debuff from the target and recovers Health proportional to the caster's max Health.

s3.source: Dispels all debuffs from an ally except for the caster before fully recovering Health. Grants superhumanization to the target for 3 turns and increases Combat Readiness by 50%. When the target is already dead, revives them with 100% Health.

s1.source: Attacks the enemy, inflicting up to 10% injuries and recovering the caster's Health. When it is not the caster's turn, damage dealt and injuries are doubled.

s1_wind.source: After attacking, when Fighting Spirit is full, consumes all Fighting Spirit to activate Wind of Protection: grants a barrier (proportional to the caster's max Health) to all allies for 2 turns, and increases Combat Readiness of the caster by 35%. (s2) At the start of the first battle, gains 50 Fighting Spirit.

s2.source: Grants 40% damage sharing from the damage received by the ally. After an ally except for the caster is attacked, when the damage suffered is 20% or more of max Health, dispels all debuffs and counterattacks.

s3.source: Attacks the enemy with a shield, inflicting up to 20% injuries. (La réduction de recharge n'existe qu'en âme brûlée.)

s1.source: (Rhianna) inflicting erosion for 2 turns. A critical hit will detonate erosion effects. (Luciella) After granting increased Attack to the caster for 1 turn, attacks the enemy and absorbs some of the damage dealt as health. (Érosion non définie par E7GW : non simulée.)

s3.source: Luciella attacks all enemies and ignores damage sharing. Rhianna dispels two buffs from all enemies, before inflicting fear for 1 turn.

s2.source: After being attacked, increases Combat Readiness by 20%.

s2_stand.source: At the start of battle, when the caster is in the front row, grants Ferocious Stand for 1 turn (allies except for the bearer cannot be selected as a target).

s2_stand_end.source: At the end of the turn, when the caster is in the front row, grants Ferocious Stand for 1 turn.

s1.source: Attacks the enemy and has a 75% chance to inflict fear for 1 turn, before recovering Health of all allies proportional to the target's max Health.

s2.source: At the start of battle, grants offering to the foremost ally (70% damage sharing of the damage received by all allies; immortality once upon lethal damage).

s2_death.source: When the ally granted offering dies, recovers Health of all allies by 50%.

s3.source: Dispels all debuffs from all allies before increasing Combat Readiness by 25%. Consumes 20% of the current Health of the ally granted offering, granting abundance to all other allies for 2 turns (after attacking, 2,000 additional damage).

s1.source: Rapidly attacks two enemies with a swordstorm, with a 50% chance to decrease their Combat Readiness by 15%.

s3.source: Attacks all enemies, decreasing Hit Chance for 2 turns. When the enemy is defeated with this skill, cooldown does not occur.

s1.source: After inflicting rupture on the enemy for 1 turn, attacks the enemy. When the caster is granted immortality, triggers a Dual Attack from the ally with the highest Attack.

s2.source: At the start of battle, grants immortality for 1 turn. When granted immortality, increases Effect Resistance by 200%.

s2_dark_moon.source: When someone uses a Soulburn, dispels all debuffs from the caster before activating Dark Moon: dispels two buffs from all enemies, before granting immortality to the caster for 3 turns and increasing Combat Readiness by 35%.

s2.source: When an ally's Health is 50% or less after being attacked, activates La Vie en Rose: dispels two debuffs from all allies and recovers Health before granting a barrier for 2 turns (proportional to the caster's max Health). (Parfum persistant non défini par E7GW : non simulé.)

s3.source: After granting increased Effectiveness to the caster for 3 turns, with a 100% chance to inflict two venom effects on all enemies for 2 turns. At the end of the turn, detonates venom effects inflicted on the target.

s1.source: Attacks the enemy with an anchor, and grants a barrier to all allies for 1 turn. (Le tour supplémentaire n'appartient qu'à Power Strike.)

s1_power.source: At the start of the turn, when Focus is full, changes to Power Strike (Consume 5 Focus): attacks the enemy, and grants an extra turn to the caster. Penetrates the target's Defense. (s2) At the start of battle, gains 3 Focus. (Gain de Concentration non précisé : +1 par tour, estimé.)

s2.source: At the start of battle, gains 3 Focus, and has a 70% (max 100%) chance to grant indomitable to all allies for 1 turn.

s2_reset.source: At the start of the turn, when the caster has a buff, dispels all debuffs from the caster and resets skill cooldown of Anchor Shot.

s3.source: Attacks the enemy with an anchor, absorbing some of the damage dealt as Health, and granting morale to all allies for 2 turns. (Compétence active : E7GW n'indique pas de recharge, valeur par défaut.)

s2.source: Attacks the enemy in a dimensional corridor, with a 75% (max 100%) chance each to dispel two buffs before fully increasing skill cooldowns. (Compétence active : recharge par défaut.)

s3.source: Attacks all enemies with an explosion and grants increased Speed to the caster for 2 turns. (Compétence active : recharge par défaut.)

s1_subspace.source: When the caster is granted mana field (Fighting Spirit 10 or more), consumes 10 Fighting Spirit to attack a random enemy with the same skill as an extra attack. (s3) At the start of the first battle, gains maximum Fighting Spirit.

s1.source: Attacks the enemy with a spear, before increasing Attack of the caster for 1 turn. When the caster is deified, activates Disappear as an extra attack (once per turn, during the caster's turn).

s1_bis.source: Disappear: Attacks the enemy with a swordstorm, and when the enemy is defeated, increases Combat Readiness of the caster by 50%. Penetrates the target's Defense by 50%.

s3.source: Attacks the enemy, dispelling two buffs before decreasing Combat Readiness by 40%. Grants deify to the caster for 3 turns (crit chance +50% when attacking, damage suffered −50%). Cannot trigger a critical hit.

s2.source: Buffs and debuffs applied to the caster become Dirge Bullets (speed and critical hit damage +20%). After using a skill on the caster's turn, when the caster has a Dirge Bullet, uses Dirge Bullet on a random enemy. Immune to debuffs which prevent movement. (Nombre d'attaques ∝ balles : une par balle, 5 au plus, estimé.)

s2_extra.source: Dirge Bullet (Gains 1 Focus): Attacks the enemy with a pistol. Damage dealt increases proportional to the caster's Defense. (Multiplicateurs de la S1, estimés.)

s1_thorn.source: At the start of the turn, when Focus is full, changes to Black Thorn (Consumes 5 Focus): attacks the enemy with thorns, and grants the maximum number of Dirge Bullets to the caster.

s3.source: Increases Combat Readiness of all allies by 40% (max 50%), and grants three Dirge Bullets to the caster. (Compétence active : recharge par défaut.)

s2.source: Envelops all enemies with the energy of the deep sea, dispelling two buffs before decreasing Combat Readiness by 25%. Grants an extra turn.

s3.source: Pierces the foremost enemy Hero with light, inflicting detain (temporarily removed from the battlefield, unaffected by Effect Resistance), and grants deterrence to the caster for 2 turns. Grants a barrier and stealth to the caster for 2 turns. (Détention : 2 tours, durée de la dissuasion.)

s1.source: Attacks all enemies with a ray, with a 65% chance to dispel one buff. When used on the caster's turn, has a 35% chance to activate Incursion as an extra attack.

s1_bis.source: Incursion: Attacks all enemies, decreasing Speed and Hit Chance for 1 turn.

s2.source: Decreases the amount of Soul acquired by the enemy by 100%. At the start of the turn, has a 100% chance to grant a random buff to the caster for 1 turn (Increase Effectiveness, Increase Critical Hit Chance, Continuous Heal).

s3.source: Attacks all enemies, decreasing Combat Readiness by a random amount between 10% and 30% and provokes for 1 turn. Increases Defense of the caster for 2 turns.

s1_counter.source: When triggered as a counterattack, activates Sword of Duty: after inflicting fracture on the caster (Attack +20%, Defense −5%, up to 10 times), attacks the enemy, and increases Combat Readiness of the caster and the foremost ally by 20%. Inflicts up to 25% injuries. (Multiplicateurs de la S1.)

s2.source: All counterattack chances of the caster are doubled, and when counterattacking, if the target is a Hero, triggers a counterattack from the foremost ally. After attacking, grants a barrier (proportional to Attack) to the caster for 2 turns.

s3.source: After inflicting fracture on the caster and dispelling all debuffs, attacks all enemies. Inflicts up to 25% injuries. (Compétence active : recharge par défaut.)

s1.source: Attacks the enemy with sword fragments. Penetrates the target's Defense. (Jauge et blessures : seulement en contre-attaque, voir s1_counter.)

s2.source: Unaffected by Combat Readiness increase and decrease effects. God of Battle: attacks the enemy with transcendent power.

s3.source: Grants God of Battle (all stats doubled) to the caster for 3 turns and fully recovers Health. While God of Battle is maintained, Sanctuary of Battle: all Heroes are immune to buffs and debuffs. Begins the first battle with a full skill cooldown count.

s1.source: Has a 85% chance to inflict seal on the enemy for 2 turns before attacking. When used on the caster's turn, has a 40% chance to activate Twisted Strike as an extra attack. Cannot trigger a critical hit.

s1_extra.source: Twisted Strike: Attacks all enemies, absorbing some of the damage dealt as Health, and has a 35% chance to inflict fear for 1 turn. When the caster is granted engulf, effect chance is doubled.

s2.source: At the start of battle, grants engulf (Effectiveness +100%; upon receiving lethal damage, grants cascade to all allies, and is dispelled). Cannot trigger a critical hit.

s3.source: Has a 35% chance to inflict curse on all enemies except for the target for 2 turns before attacking the enemy. When the caster is granted engulf, effect chance is doubled. Cannot trigger a critical hit.

s2.source: Swiftly attacks the enemy, dispelling all buffs before decreasing Combat Readiness by 30% and inflicting pilfer (Attack, Health, Defense −20%; grants spoils +20% to the attacker, up to 4). Grants increased Attack to the caster for 2 turns and an extra turn.

s3.source: Nimbly attacks the enemy. After attacking, dispels all buffs from the caster and inflicts stun for 1 turn on the caster, and deals 7000 fixed damage to all enemies.

s1.source: Attacks the enemy with magic, and grants immunity to the caster for 1 turn. When it is the caster's turn, activates Vollzanbel as an extra attack (gain 1 Soul, all enemies).

s1_bis.source: Vollzanbel: Attacks all enemies with flame magic.

s2.source: During battle, when Soul is 4 or higher, grants Defensive Magic (when attacked, consumes 4 Soul, nullifying damage from skills). After being attacked, increases Combat Readiness of all allies by 10%.

s3.source: After granting increased Attack to the caster for 3 turns, attacks all enemies with lightning magic, dispelling all buffs.

s1.source: Attacks the enemy with moonlight. When the caster is granted dawn, activates Light of Condemnation as an extra attack (once per turn, during the caster's turn).

s1_bis.source: Light of Condemnation (Acquire 5 Soul): Attacks all enemies and consumes all Soul, inflicting 1,000 additional damage. Additional damage increases proportional to the amount of consumed Soul, up to 25,000. (1 000 par Âme, estimé.)

s2.source: At the end of an ally's turn, when Soul is 10 or higher, increases Combat Readiness of the caster by 20%.

s3.source: Has a 85% chance each to inflict block for 2 turns and silence for 1 turn on all enemies. Grants dawn (Soul acquired +100%; after attacking, 25% chance to stun) and a barrier (proportional to max Health) to the caster for 3 turns.

s1.source: Attacks the enemy with light, and recovers Health of all allies. Amount recovered increases proportional to the caster's max Health.

s2.source: At the start of the first battle, grants four divinity effects (immune to debuffs; Health and Defense +20% per stack).

s2_fragment.source: When an ally except for the caster dies, consumes one divinity to revive them as a Fragment of Life for 2 turns and increase Combat Readiness by 20% (max 30%). (Fragment de vie puis retour au héros : résurrection à 100 % des PV, estimé.)

s3.source: Reconstructs the world to fully recover Health of all allies. (Retour temporel : non simulé. Compétence active : recharge par défaut.)

s1.source: Attacks the enemy, with a 75% chance to decrease Defense for 1 turn. When it is the caster's turn, uses En Passant as an extra attack.

s1_bis.source: En Passant: Attacks all enemies, with a 60% chance to decrease Attack for 1 turn.

s2.source: At the start of battle, Speed of the caster is fixed going forward, and Speed of all Heroes except for the caster is limited to a maximum of 90% of the caster's Speed. On the caster's turn, Combat Readiness increase effects of all Heroes is not applied.

s3.source: Attacks all enemies, decreasing buff durations by 2 turns and a 100% chance to inflict unable to be buffed for 2 turns. Penetrates the target's Defense.

s1.source: Attacks the enemy with Sigurd Scythe, before increasing Combat Readiness of the caster by 20%. When used on the caster's turn, activates Final Deliverance as an extra attack. Cannot trigger a critical hit; penetrates Defense by 85%.

s1_bis.source: Final Deliverance: Attacks all enemies, before granting stealth to the caster for 1 turn and decreasing skill cooldowns by 2 turns.

s2.source: All Heroes cannot revive and cannot be granted immortality. When attacking, penetrates the target's Defense by 85%, and cannot trigger a critical hit or a heavy blow.

s3.source: After granting increased Attack to the caster for 3 turns, attacks the enemy. When the target is a Hero, ignores damage share. Cannot trigger a critical hit; penetrates Defense by 85%.

s2.source: Releases divinity, granting skill nullifier once to the caster, and cloning a target Hero except for the caster for 1 turn. Grants an extra turn. (Clonage : non simulé.)
Allies and enemies cannot revive. Upon receiving lethal damage, grants immortality for 1 turn. Immortality effect can only be activated once every 5 turns.
After inflicting seal and collapse (max Health −25%, doubled on Heroes) on the enemy for 2 turns, attacks the enemy. A critical hit will grant an extra turn.

s3.source: Attacks all enemies with divinity and penetrates the target's Defense. (Compétence active : recharge par défaut.)

s3_covenant.source: At the start of the first battle, grants Sacred Covenant for 5 turns (cannot be affected by debuffs; upon dying, revives with 100% Health).

s1.source: Attacks the enemy with a spear, and increases Combat Readiness of the caster by 20%.

s2.source: Attacks the enemy, decreasing Defense for 1 turn, and increasing Combat Readiness of the caster by 50%. (Dégâts additionnels de zone non chiffrés : non simulés.)

s3.source: Dispels all buffs from all enemies before sealing for 2 turns.

s3_nullifier.source: At the start of the first battle, grants skill effect nullifier once to the caster (nullifies an effect from skills of enemy Heroes).

s2.source: At the start of an enemy's extra turn, dispels all debuffs from all allies and grants skill nullifier once and immunity for 2 turns. Can only be activated once every 2 turns.

s3.source: Increases Attack of all allies for 2 turns (vigor: Attack and Defense +30%) and Combat Readiness by 20%.

s1.source: Attacks the enemy with coral magic and decreases Combat Readiness by 20%.

s2.source: With a 100% chance to grant cascade to all allies. Grants skill nullifier once and an extra turn to the caster.

s3.source: Fixes all enemies in a frame, dispelling two buffs before a 100% chance each to inflict immobilize and restrict for 1 turn. Concealment will remain throughout the battle (cannot be targeted while another ally is present).

s3_conceal.source: Concealment will remain throughout the battle.

s1.source: Attacks the enemy, increasing Combat Readiness of the caster by 15%. When Purge is on cooldown, activates Disciplinary Action as an extra attack.

s1_bis.source: Disciplinary Action: Attacks the enemy, inflicting up to 10% injuries. A successful attack always results in a critical hit.

s2.source: Increases Soulburn consumption of the enemy by 100%. When the caster is not inflicted with a debuff, increases Effect Resistance of all allies by 40%.

s1.source: Attacks the enemy with a blade, with a 80% chance each to inflict two bleeding effects for 2 turns. At the end of the turn, detonates bleeding effects inflicted on the target.

s2.source: After an ally except for the caster uses a Single Attack, grants swift attack (end of turn: CR +50%) to the ally, and activates Flank Strike against the enemy target: dispelling one buff and inflicting decreased Defense for 2 turns, before increasing Combat Readiness of the caster by 20%.

s3.source: After granting overload (Attack and Speed +50%; then energy depletion −50% for 1 turn) to the caster for 2 turns, attacks all enemies, dispelling two buffs, and has a 100% chance to inflict a bomb for 2 turns. At the end of the turn, detonates bombs inflicted on the target.

s1.source: Attacks the enemy with wind and has a 25% (max 35%) chance to inflict stun for 1 turn, before recovering Health of all allies proportional to the target's max Health.

s2.source: When attacked, grants 25% (max 20%) damage reduction. After an enemy uses a skill, when granted a barrier, activates Desert Storm: inflicts barrier inversion on all enemies before decreasing Combat Readiness by 20%. Increases Combat Readiness of the caster by 20%.

s3.source: Bastet roars, dispelling all debuffs from all allies before increasing Combat Readiness by 20% (max 30%). (Compétence active : recharge par défaut.)

s1.source: Attacks the enemy, and dispels one debuff from an ally.

s2.source: After an enemy uses a skill, when an ally is inflicted with poison or venom, dispels all debuffs from the caster and activates Cleanse: dispels all debuffs from all allies and grants immunity for 1 turn, before resetting skill cooldowns of the caster. Can only be activated once every 1 turn.

s3.source: Attacks all enemies, and increases Combat Readiness of the caster by 50%. A successful attack inflicts 4000 fixed damage. (Cumul +4 000 par utilisation : non simulé.)

s2.source: Increases Evasion of all allies by 30%. After attacking, when Fighting Spirit is full, consumes it all, granting Demon Blade Unleashed to the caster for 1 turn, before activating Blade Art: Bewitching Blossom: attacks all enemies, and increase Combat Readiness of the caster by 50%. (Consommation des PV et gain d'Esprit non chiffrés : non simulés / estimés.)

s2_counter.source: When an ally except for the caster evades, counterattacks.

s3.source: Dispel all buffs from all enemies before inflicting beguile (end of turn: 10% of max Health to the bearer's allies) and decreased Hit Chance for 2 turns.

s1.source: Attacks the enemy with a sword, inflicting injuries (up to 10% of max Health every time this skill is used).

s2.source: After every attack suffered by an ally, increases Combat Readiness of the caster by 10%.

s3.source: Attacks the enemy with a spear, inflicting injuries (up to 20%), before dispelling two debuffs from all allies and granting indomitable for 2 turns. (Compétence active : recharge par défaut.)

s1.source: Attacks the enemy with a fan, before granting immunity to the caster for 1 turn. A successful attack always results in a critical hit.

s2.source: When an ally is attacked, gains 20 Fighting Spirit, and when Fighting Spirit is full, consumes all Fighting Spirit to activate All Eyes on Me: attacks all enemies, and increases Combat Readiness of the caster by 20%. A successful attack always results in a critical hit.

s2_fervor.source: After attacking, increases Attack of the caster by 10%. This effect can stack up to 5 times.

s3.source: Attacks the enemy by moving unpredictably, before granting vigor to the caster for 2 turns. A successful attack always results in a critical hit.

s1.source: Attacks with a giant sword before granting the caster immunity for 1 turn. (Always Results in a Critical Hit.)

s2.source: Decreases damage suffered from a critical hit by 30%. Decreases damage suffered from a critical hit for all allies except for the caster by 15%. At the moment the caster suffers a critical hit, increases Combat Readiness of the caster by 15%. Immune to debuffs which prevent movement.

s3.source: Smashes the enemy with a sword and attacks. When the enemy is defeated, inflicts extinction. Penetrates the target's Defense by 50%. (Bonus contre les héros Ténèbres : non simulé.)

s1.source: Attacks the enemy with holy light, and recovers Health of allies proportional to the target's max Health.

s2.source: Unaffected by decreases to Combat Readiness. At the end of someone's turn, when the enemy is granted immortality, dispels all debuffs from all allies and grants radiance (damage suffered −50%) for 2 turns, before increasing Combat Readiness of the caster by 50%.

s2_dispel.source: At the start of the turn, dispels immortality from all enemies. Ignores Effect Resistance.

s3.source: Dispels two debuffs from all allies, and grants immunity for 2 turns before increasing Combat Readiness by 20%.

s1.source: Attacks all enemies with light, with a 50% (max 65%) chance to dispel one buff. Deals 1000 additional damage regardless of whether the attack hits.

s2.source: At the start of battle, when in the front row, grants offense mission (completed when allies attack 10 times). When a mission is complete, dispels all debuffs from the caster, and activates Last Words of a Fallen Star: grants knowledge of the stars (additional damage +100%) to all allies, and grants an extra turn to the caster.

s2_defense.source: When in the back row, grants defense mission (completed when allies are attacked 10 times), then Last Words of a Fallen Star.

s3.source: Attacks all enemies with a drone, increasing skill cooldowns by 1 turn. Deals 3000 additional damage regardless of whether the attack hits. (Compétence active : recharge par défaut.)
